edges: The Jester tells Dorothy that Princess Gayelette and Prince Quelala have gone missing.
The Jester freezes when reminded of his role.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Dorothy and Toto reclaim the silver shoes.
Dorothy encounters the Jester at Princess Gayelette's palace.
Wiser informs Dorothy that she is in Gillikin Country.
Dorothy reunites with Aunt Em and Uncle Henry in Kansas.
Glinda tells Dorothy that she must return to Oz to save her friends.
Dorothy sees a rainbow which she believes is a goodbye from Princess Ozma.
Dorothy finds the Wicked Witch of the West's wand in the palace.
